issues.description: In the reference solution for Aufgabe 09 the WHERE clause compares Gemeinde.name to the numeric literal 12345 (Gemeinde.name=12345). The task in the problem statement asks for zoos in a Gemeinde named "Erlangen" (a string). This is a type/value mismatch and will produce incorrect results or SQL errors, and contradicts the problem requirement.
issues.suggestedFix:
In aufgabe09.sql update the WHERE condition to compare the Gemeinde.name to the string 'Erlangen' and keep the join condition. For example:
SELECT Zoo.name
FROM Zoo, Gemeinde
WHERE Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel
  AND Gemeinde.name = 'Erlangen';
